icp_note: Colleges, universities, or career centers serving students (post-12th or undergrad) who want practical marketing/content/entrepreneurship skills and value portfolio-building over traditional degrees.

dimensions.label: Student profile fit
dimensions.guidance: High: institution serves students interested in marketing, content, startups, or non-traditional careers; students value skills over grades. Low: institution focused on traditional academic paths (medicine, law, engineering theory) with no appetite for experiential learning.

dimensions.label: Partnership openness
dimensions.guidance: High: institution actively seeks industry tie-ups, co-curricular programs, or alternative credentials; leadership is innovative. Low: rigid curriculum, no appetite for external programs, or views non-degree offerings as competitive threats.

dimensions.label: Placement pressure
dimensions.guidance: High: institution struggles with graduate employability, faces parent/student pressure for job outcomes, or has weak industry connections. Low: strong placement record already, or students pursue further study rather than jobs.

dimensions.label: Budget & scale potential
dimensions.guidance: High: large student cohorts (500+ in target demographic), budget for partnerships or co-branded programs, willingness to pilot. Low: small institution, tight budgets, or no mechanism to fund/promote external programs.
